Course pages for test/pageClean.test.ts: the cleaner must hide their noise and keep every word of
the lesson. Only openly licensed text is kept here (this repository is public).

mlfb-readme.md              https://github.com/microsoft/ML-For-Beginners/blob/main/README.md (MIT), as served on 13 November 2026
mlfb-regression-tools.md    https://github.com/microsoft/ML-For-Beginners/blob/main/2-Regression/1-Tools/README.md (MIT), same day

zoomcamp-*.md are written for Tide: they copy the layout of DataTalksClub's Zoomcamp pages (the
register banner, the link bar, badges, the quick-links table, community notes, learner stories,
sponsors, "About DataTalks.Club") with Tide's own words, because the Zoomcamps state no licence and
their text can't be redistributed. The test also reads the real pages when they are on this Mac
(TIDE_CLEAN_REAL=<folder of the downloaded READMEs>), without keeping them here.
